header: Bridged Polycyclic Heterocycles Involving Unexpected Rearrangements

subquestions.text_open:
9.1 The reaction below is catalyzed by AgOTf.
9.1.1 The reaction initially forms a nitrogen-containing heterocyclic intermediate. Write the SMILES representations of the 4 key intermediates and of the product formed after the 1,3-dipolar cycloaddition. Add a textual description if necessary.

text_images.description: 'O/N=C/C1=CC=CC=C1C#CC2=CC=CC=C2' reacts with 'O=S(OC1=CC=CC=C1[Si](C)(C)C)(C(F)(F)F)=O' under AgOTf (10mol%), TBAF (3.0equiv), THF, 50°C conditions.

subquestions.text_open: 9.1.2 However, the product described in 9.1.1 is not observed; the product formed after its further rearrangement is shown below. Write the SMILES representation of 1 key intermediate in the reaction.

9.2 Some steps of the reaction below are very similar to those in 9.1. PhIO (iodosylbenzene) is a hypervalent iodine oxidant commonly used for the oxidative dearomatization of electron-rich arenes in the presence of a nucleophilic solvent. 9.2.1 Write the SMILES representation of the key OMe-containing electrophilic species formed by reaction of the starting material with PhIO in MeOH.

text_images.description: 'CC1=CC=C(NS(C2=CC=C(C)C=C2)(=O)=O)C(C#CC3=CC=CC=C3)=C1' first reacts with iodosylbenzene, PhI=O, in methanol at room temperature for 5min, and then reacts with 'O/N=C/C1=CC=CC=C1C#CC2=CC=CC=C2' (1.1 equiv) under AgOTf (10 mol%) in dichloroethane at room temperature.

subquestions.text_open: 9.2.2 The key electrophilic species then cyclizes to give a key intermediate, which undergoes a [3 + 3] cycloaddition with an intermediate from 9.1.1. Write the SMILES representations of the cyclized key intermediate and the cycloaddition product. Hint: The product contains a pyrrole ring system and has 1H NMR (400 MHz, $CDCl_3$) δ 7.95-7.93 (m, 2 H), 7.51-7.41 (m, 9 H), 7.31-7.27 (m, 2 H), 7.23 (d, J = 8.1 Hz, 2 H), 7.10 (d, J = 8.1 Hz, 2 H), 6.94 (d, J = 10.4 Hz, 1 H), 6.89-6.87 (m, 1 H), 5.94 (s, 1 H), 5.70 (s, 1 H), 5.68 (d, J = 10.3 Hz, 1 H), 4.66 (s, 1 H), 3.20 (s, 3 H), 2.31 (s, 3 H), 1.21 (s, 3 H).

9.2.3 However, when the product above is stirred in 1,4-dioxane at 90 °C for 2 hours, it undergoes a reaction similar to that in 9.1. Write the SMILES representations of the 2 key intermediates and the final product.
9.4 EWG is an acyclic electron-withdrawing group. By inference from 9.1 and 9.2, write the SMILES representation of 1 key tetracyclic intermediate in the reaction below.

text_images.description: 'O/N=C/C1=CC=CC=C1C#CC2=CC=CC=C2' reacts with 'C=C=C-EWG' under 5 mol% AgOTf catalysis in DMSO, first at 60 °C for 20min and then at room temperature for 12h, to give 'O=C1C[C@@H]2C3=CC=CC=C3[C@@H](N=C2C4=CC=CC=C4)[C@@H]1[EWG]'.
